notes: - **A failed server is retried once, then the walk moves on.** Three retries against one server cost about two minutes on this ISP (each failed dial is a 12 s R-UDP timeout and four 10 s TLS ports, measured in the 2026-11-19 logcat) before the failover walk switched to a server that might actually carry traffic — the opposite of "if failed go to next until one is connected". The default is now one retry, and a stored three from an earlier install is migrated to it once; a three the user sets deliberately afterwards is honoured.
